summary: After upgrading to 2.6, OAuth and SSO authenticators are disabled and their callback_url moves from controller to platform gateway and is generated per authenticator; copy it from the authenticator details into your IdP (GitHub, Entra ID, Keycloak, OIDC, Google) and re-enable the authenticator.
questions: SSO login fails after upgrading to AAP 2.6
Where do I find the callback URL for my authenticator?
Why is my authentication method disabled after upgrade?
